  A regular meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Davis at 5:32 p.m., on

  for those who visit the downtown, then it will be a success; this is just
  adding another layer of security to our downtown area; don’t understand
  why armed security has to be deployed in order to provide secure
  engagement in our downtown; and, not necessarily in support of having
  armed officers, but trust DTSM’s recommendation that having this
  addition will provide a perception of a more safe downtown.

  Motion by Councilmember de la Torre, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem
  Negrete, to adopt the staff recommendation, with the proposed language
  change from staff.

  Councilmember Zwick proposed a friendly amendment that the security
  services not be armed. The motion was not considered friendly by the
  maker and seconder.

  Councilmember Zwick proposed a friendly amendment that no rounds be
  chambered until that officer is engaged in an escalating forceful situation.
  The motion was not considered friendly by the maker.

  Substitute motion by Councilmember Zwick, to approve the
  recommendation with the added stipulation that Cover 6 not deploy
  security forces that are armed with firearms. There being no second, the
  motion did not pass.
